usage: 金魚 (gam1 jyu4) is a noun referring to the small ornamental fish often kept in aquariums or ponds.
It can be used as the subject or object in sentences, e.g. “我養咗好多金魚” (I have kept many goldfish).
You can describe the color or size of 金魚 with adjectives, for example, “紅色金魚” means red goldfish.
金魚 is often used with measure words like 隻 (zek3) when counting them, e.g. 一隻金魚 (one goldfish).
When talking about pets, 金魚 usually implies a common, easy-to-care-for aquatic pet.
